title: A TOCTOU Race Condition
description: A Mermaid sequence diagram of a Time-Of-Check to Time-Of-Use (TOCTOU) race condition: a privileged process checks /tmp/x, an attacker swaps it for a symlink to /etc/shadow inside the critical window, and the process then follows the symlink. Includes the structural fix.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

learningObjectives: Explain how the gap between a check (T1) and a use (T2) creates an exploitable window.
Trace a symlink-swap TOCTOU attack against a privileged process.
Identify the structural fix that eliminates the window rather than shrinking it.

instructionalStrategies: Read top to bottom; pause at the red critical window to ask what the attacker changed.
Connect the failure to the fix: check and use must refer to the same object (a file descriptor).

assessmentQuestions.question: Why does narrowing the time between access() and open() reduce but not eliminate the TOCTOU risk?
How does operating on a file descriptor (instead of re-resolving the path) close the window?
